pediatricPearls: Use pediatric dosing of medications or electrical therapy for a pediatric patient < 37 kg and as defined by HandTevy.
Pediatric hypotension is defined as SBP < 70 + (age in years x 2) mmHg
differential: headache, stroke, CNS lesions, Trauma or hemorrhage)

pl1: Inhaled isopropyl alcohol wipe to help control nausea
Adult: Diphenhydramine if patient allergic to Ondansetron and Droperidol
IV fluid with Isotonic Crystalloid as needed for dehydration
Adult: Tranexamic acid (TXA) with confirmed upper or lower GI bleeding AND hypotension if < 3 hours since bleeding onset
